events.title: Clop ransomware exploits PLM product zero-day flaw in major data breach
events.one_liner: The Clop ransomware gang exploited an unpatched zero-day vulnerability (CVE-2026-12569) in PTC Windchill and FlexPLM product lifecycle management platforms to breach nearly 50 companies. The flaw enables unauthenticated remote code execution, allowing deployment of web shells for data exfiltration.
takeaways: CVE-2026-12569: Deserialization vulnerability in PTC Windchill and FlexPLM
Nearly 50 companies affected; high-profile victims: Shell (89GB), GE (391GB), Philips (15.5GB), Fiserv
Vulnerability enables unauthenticated remote code execution and web shell deployment
PTC issued patch CS473270
Exfiltrated data includes engineering plans, blueprints, project documents

events.title: Ukraine expands military targets to second major Russian tech facility
events.one_liner: Ukraine struck two major Yandex data centres in Russia within consecutive days in early October, knocking out supercomputers and disrupting services for millions of Russians and dependent businesses. Yandex shares fell over 4% as the company faced challenges maintaining navigation, AI, music, and cloud services.
takeaways: October 8: Strike on Sasovo data centre housing 2 of 3 Yandex AI supercomputers
October 9: Strike on Kaluga region facility, Yandex's largest data centre; multiple modules destroyed
Yandex shares fell >4% on Moscow exchange
Tens of thousands of servers affected; dating app with 8,000 users lost backup database access
Yandex announced data migration deal with other cloud providers
